status: Six failures reproduced; three distinct capability/fixture causes confirmed; gate remains failing
command: LAKEQL_CONFORMANCE=1 pnpm exec vitest run -c vitest.conformance.config.ts -t 'alp_extended|bson.parquet|large_string_map'

findings.cause: Upstream metadata enum maps ALP=10 to undefined; readDataPage then rejects unsupported encoding undefined. Fixture ALP columns use UNCOMPRESSED codec, while reference PLAIN columns use ZSTD. The filename is not evidence of a ZSTD defect.
findings.nextWork: Implement bounded ALP page decoding with vector sizes from the page header, exceptions and bitwise float/double parity against the in-file PLAIN reference. Preserve NaN payloads in decoder-level assertions.

findings.cause: Schema validation intentionally rejects BSON with LAKEQL_UNSUPPORTED_PARQUET_FEATURE before page reads. Existing bson-rejection.test.ts enforces this behavior; conformance currently expects successful decoding.
findings.nextWork: Resolve the decoding contract explicitly and implement bounded BSON decoding if supporting this annotation; do not silently return raw bytes as decoded BSON or remove the conformance assertion.

findings.cause: BROTLI is not registered. Independently, the fixture generator produces two rows each with a 1 GiB string; the key column advertises 2147483749 uncompressed bytes. Successful full materialization cannot satisfy the owned test 64 MiB cap.
findings.nextWork: Provide a bounded Brotli codec contract and explicit oversized-value admission before allocation. Conformance must distinguish value decoding from expected budget rejection using metadata/fixture-derived bounds, not a filename skip. A smaller real Brotli fixture must prove successful decoding.

limits: Targeted reproduction only; this does not replace the full release acceptance gate.
No unsafe multi-gigabyte decode was attempted. Metadata was read through the production footer reader.
All six cases remain failures, not waived or reclassified as passes.
